reference: R HonestDiD 0.2.8 on the mpdta panel: honest_did() (HonestDiD:::honest_did.AGGTEobj) on did's Callaway-Sant'Anna event study with base_period = 'universal' (relative_magnitude with C-LF and Conditional, smoothness with FLCI and C-LF, at honest_did's 100 grid points), and createSensitivityResults(_relativeMagnitudes) on a fixest TWFE event study of the never-treated counties and the 2006 cohort (C-LF, Conditional, FLCI, C-F), with the event studies they used. R's folded-normal quantile is replaced by the exact one, and its least-favorable critical values are recorded with fingerprints of their covariances, so the comparisons are exact. Three TWFE cases in which R stops with an error are recorded with the message.
